intro: Everything new in beta 21, on screen, before the final release test: Lite mode, the keyboard map, the first-launch setup and the tour. Then the Workshop page as Steam will show it, the gallery, what the release test checks and the change note.

items.title: Lite: the windows in use
items.look: Left: Lite. Right: the same moment in Full.
items.what: Buttons with one bold line, filled; Filter and List or Grid in words; no Same type buttons; no marks strip on the item card; the watch in the corner.

items.title: Lite: a question with OK and Cancel
items.look: OK in your positive color, Cancel in your negative color.
items.what: The colors come from the game's Accessibility options, so each player sees their own.

items.title: Lite: a radio
items.look: Power and Mute as radio buttons; no preset keys.
items.what: The game's own radios have no presets, so Lite leaves them out.

items.title: Lite: an appliance
items.look: On and Off as radio buttons.
items.what: Noticed: when the World window opens wide for Crafting it covers the corner watch. Say if the watch should move out of its way.

items.title: Lite: the dashboard
items.look: Every car gets the black Dash Elite.

items.title: Lite: the watch
items.look: A plain clock in the corner: the time large on the left; the day, month and date over the temperature on the right; the game's speed as one row of choices.

items.title: Lite: ZeD setup
items.look: Style at the top of Look; Additions and Chords put away.
items.what: Picking Lite also sets ZeD's extras to the Vanilla preset.

items.title: The Mods screen: Lite, with folder colors
items.look: Profiles and Load order stay, as in the game's own; folders go in Lite.
items.what: Folder colors (new): in Full, a folder's menu has Color..., and the folder's row and its mods' rows take a light wash of it.

items.title: Map: always light
items.look: ZeD setup, Look, Map: Always light. The Survey map keeps its Light colors while the theme is Dark.
items.what: High contrast keeps its own colors. Follows the theme is the default.

items.title: Mods folders with colors
items.look: Each folder's row and its mods' rows washed in the folder's color.
items.what: Color... in a folder's menu or its pane: No color or one of eight accent colors.

items.title: A folder's Color... menu
items.look: The menu open beside the folder, Blue ticked.

items.title: The keyboard map
items.look: Every key the game uses lit; a key with two jobs in your negative color; a key picked and an action waiting for its new key.

items.title: Welcome: pick your own
items.look: Light picked: the desk and the preview change as you pick.
items.what: Shows once, the first time ZeD runs. Skip puts everything back.

items.title: Welcome: load a setup
items.what: Reads Zomboid/Lua/ZeD_setup.txt, written by Save setup here or on another machine.

items.title: Tour 4 of 11: the tabs
items.what: The game's icons from the top left corner live here now, as tabs down the side.

items.title: Tour 5 of 11: Health
items.what: Shows how to treat a wound.

items.title: Tour 6 of 11: your ID
items.what: Your weight, with a plus or a minus while it changes.

items.title: Tour 8 of 11: an item's card
items.what: Opens the card of the first thing you carry.

items.title: Tour 11 of 11: Messages and the guide
items.what: Points at the belt's Messages note, where ZeD's guide bubble comes out on the first game.

description_notes: Changed from beta 20: the version in the beta line, the Gadgets bullet names Lite mode, the Controller bullet names the keyboard map, and picture 2's map close-up is now the Light Survey map at the Fossoil (your note).
gallery_notes: No gallery changes for beta 21: the 71 pictures from beta 20 stay as they are. Lite mode, the keyboard map, the setup and the tour are not in the gallery yet; tell me if you want pictures of them added.
tests_lead: The full release test runs every script below at 4K and on the true Steam Deck screen. The last full run (run 11, beta 20) had 10 scripts and 1,406 checks, all passing. Beta 21 adds three scripts and about 200 checks; nothing was removed.

tests.what: Lite mode: Style picked in ZeD setup like a player; the plain forms switch on; the Vanilla preset; Additions and Chords hidden; button colors from the game's good and bad colors; the black Dash Elite; the watch's speed row; no presets, memory key or lamp on any radio; Filter and List or Grid as words; no Same type; no marks strip; then Full back.
Lite on the main menu: no desk apps or notes; the Mods screen keeps Profiles and Load order. (A main-menu run, beside the release test.)

The keyboard map: opens from the window menu; lists every binding; lights only bound keys; a changed key works at once, is written the game's way and survives a restart; a clash in the bad color; Reset asks once. Your own key file is put back byte for byte.
The first-launch setup: opens by itself only the first time; every choice sets its option; Skip restores; Save and Load a setup. (Two main-menu launches.)

The tour: starts by itself when asked for; all seven balloons in order, each pointing at its thing; a step with nothing on screen is passed over; Stop, Done, the controller's words, A and B. Two new checks: the tour shows every step when it starts with both windows shut, and its keys never cover what the balloon points at. And that the card step has a card open.

Their Simple legs used the eight old Simple switches, which Lite retired. They now use the one Style switch (Lite or Full). rt_vehicles drops the plain dashboard strip (gone; Lite's dash is checked in rt_lite) and now checks that the cabin pop-out opens in Lite. rt_system's check of the old Immersive-or-simple forms now flips Style and checks the dashboard has no plain form.
tests.checks: done, runs with the release test

tests_notes: Nothing was removed. Not covered by a script: how the Options wheel's Style slice looks, how the radio-button rows draw, and the tour on a real controller (no controller on the test machine).

Found and fixed while taking these pictures: the tour skipped the two windows when they had been opened and shut before it began; its Next and Stop keys sat over the belt; two lines on the welcome window ran past their edges; Load was offered with no setup file to load.
In these pictures a few zombies stand inside the Fossoil near Angel. They are the QA save's own and don't attack during tests; say if you want the pictures retaken without them.
